name: Player Analytics
description: Tracks player performance, statistics, and provides AI-based training tips to improve your game.
author: IO-Darts-Agent Team

dataRetentionDays.label: Data Retention (Days)
dataRetentionDays.description: Number of days to keep detailed throw data. Set to 0 for unlimited.

aiProvider.label: AI Provider
aiProvider.description: Select the AI provider for generating training tips

aiApiKey.label: AI API Key
aiApiKey.description: API key for the selected AI provider (not needed for Ollama)

ollamaHost.label: Ollama Host
ollamaHost.description: Hostname or IP address of the Ollama server

ollamaModel.label: Ollama Model
ollamaModel.description: Model to use for Ollama (e.g., llama3, mistral)

trackAllPlayers.label: Track All Players
trackAllPlayers.description: Track statistics for all players, not just registered ones

generateTipsAfterMatch.label: Generate Tips After Match
generateTipsAfterMatch.description: Automatically generate training tips after each match ends

minMatchesForTips.label: Minimum Matches for Tips
minMatchesForTips.description: Minimum number of matches required before generating training tips
